FREELANCE AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made as of October 5, 2026 between Alder Example Studio ("Client") and Rowan Sample ("Freelancer").
The Freelancer will design a logo for the Client.
The Client will pay the Freelancer $1,500 on delivery.
Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, with immediate effect.
